title: Statistical Computing with Python and R
curriculum_locator: Printed page 8, Stat H-108; Stat H-209; Stat H-310; Stat H-311; University of Dhaka four-year B.S. Honours Statistics curriculum, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Programming Foundations for Statistical Data: Object Models, Vectors, Data Frames, and Memory Structures in Python and R
scope: Object models, types, and scalar representations in Python and R
NumPy ndarray memory layout, strides, and C- vs Fortran-contiguous buffers
R atomic vectors, factors, lists, attributes, and S3/S4 object paradigms
Copy-on-modify semantics vs pointer references and memory mutation
Vectorized array broadcasting, SIMD instructions, and avoiding interpreter loops
worked_questions: Memory layout, stride calculation, and cache-friendly matrix traversal in NumPy arrays
Copy-on-modify overhead analysis and in-place reference mutation in R data structures
Vectorized broadcasting algebra and vectorized execution benchmarking vs nested procedural loops

units.title: Data Wrangling, Tabular Transformation, Relational Joins, and Missing-Data Processing
scope: Tabular structures: pandas DataFrame vs R data.table and tibble
Relational algebra joins: inner, outer, semi-joins, anti-joins, and hash vs sort-merge algorithms
Reshaping algorithms: wide-to-long and long-to-wide pivots (melt, dcast, pivot_longer)
Missing data representations: IEEE 754 NaN, None, typed NA in R, and three-valued logic
Split-apply-combine strategies, grouped aggregations, and window functions
worked_questions: Complexity analysis and execution mechanics of hash joins vs nested-loop joins on large relational frames
Formal algebraic transformation of multi-index hierarchical data from wide to normalized long form
Three-valued logical propagation and design-consistent imputation across grouped tabular data

units.title: Statistical Graphics, Grammar of Graphics, Exploratory Data Analysis, and Diagnostic Visualizations
scope: Leland Wilkinson's Grammar of Graphics and Jacques Bertin's semiology of visual signs
Declarative layered grammar in ggplot2 vs imperative axes in matplotlib/seaborn
Kernel density estimation (KDE), bandwidth selection (AMISE, Sheather-Jones), and boundary kernels
Bivariate diagnostics: hexbin smoothing, contour level sets, Q-Q plots, and residual diagnostics
Perceptually uniform color maps (Viridis, CIELAB) and visual accessibility standards
worked_questions: Analytical derivation of optimal Gaussian kernel bandwidth via asymptotic mean integrated squared error (AMISE)
Construction and theoretical quantile mapping of normal Q-Q plots with finite-sample envelope bounds
Visual perception principles: Weber-Fechner law and comparative visual decoding efficiency across graphic encodings

units.title: Numerical Linear Algebra, Floating-Point Arithmetic, QR/SVD Decompositions, and Matrix Computations
scope: IEEE 754 floating-point arithmetic, machine epsilon, subnormal numbers, and condition numbers
Catastrophic cancellation in sample variance formulas: naive two-pass vs Welford's algorithm
Linear regression solvers: Normal Equations vs Cholesky vs Householder QR decomposition
Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, and PCA
Low-rank matrix approximation (Eckart-Young-Mirsky) and sparse CSR/CSC representations
worked_questions: Error analysis of catastrophic cancellation in naive sample variance and mathematical proof of Welford's recurrence
Computational stability and flop count comparison: Cholesky decomposition vs Householder QR decomposition for OLS estimation
Derivation of principal components via SVD and proof of the Eckart-Young-Mirsky optimal low-rank matrix approximation

units.title: Random Number Generation, Pseudo-Random Streams, Inversion/Rejection Sampling, and Monte Carlo Integration
scope: Pseudo-random number generation: LCG, Mersenne Twister (MT19937), PCG, and spectral tests
Non-uniform sampling: Inverse Transform method, Box-Muller transform, Marsaglia polar method
Acceptance-Rejection Sampling: envelope condition, optimal majorizing constant c, and acceptance rates
Monte Carlo Integration: standard error decay, Antithetic Variates, and Control Variates
Importance Sampling: choice of instrumental density, weight degeneration, and effective sample size
worked_questions: Theoretical derivation of Box-Muller transform via bivariate polar coordinates and Jacobian determinant
Acceptance-Rejection sampling derivation for a Beta(2, 3) distribution using a uniform proposal, finding optimal envelope c
Analytical variance reduction proof: Antithetic Variates vs independent Monte Carlo integration for monotone functions

units.title: Resampling Methods: Nonparametric Bootstrap, Jackknife, Permutation Tests, and Cross-Validation
scope: Empirical Distribution Function (EDF), Glivenko-Cantelli theorem, and the plug-in principle
Nonparametric bootstrap: resample distributions, bootstrap standard errors, and percentile/Studentized/BCa intervals
The Jackknife: leave-one-out pseudovalues, bias reduction, and connection to influence curves
Permutation tests: exact combinatorial enumeration and Monte Carlo approximations
Cross-validation: K-fold CV, Leave-One-Out CV, and fast leverage shortcuts in linear models
worked_questions: Analytical derivation of the fast LOOCV leverage identity e_[i] = e_i / (1 - h_ii) in linear regression
Exact combinatorial enumeration and Monte Carlo approximation of a two-sample permutation test
Jackknife bias-reduction proof and derivation of the Jackknife variance estimator for sample quantiles

units.title: Numerical Optimization in Statistics: Newton-Raphson, Fisher Scoring, Nelder-Mead, and the EM Algorithm
scope: Optimization landscapes: convexity, gradients, Hessian positive definiteness, and condition numbers
Unconstrained algorithms: Gradient Descent, Newton-Raphson method, and backtracking line search
Fisher Scoring and Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS) for Generalized Linear Models
Derivative-free Nelder-Mead simplex algorithm: reflection, expansion, contraction, and shrink
Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm: latent variables, Q-function, Jensen's inequality proof of monotonic ascent, and Gaussian Mixture Models
worked_questions: Detailed step-by-step derivation of IRLS for logistic regression and equivalence to Fisher scoring
Mathematical proof of monotonic likelihood increase L(theta^(t+1)) >= L(theta^(t)) in the EM algorithm via Jensen's inequality
Newton-Raphson vs Fisher Scoring convergence rate and numerical step computation for a Gamma GLM

units.title: Statistical Modeling Workflows, Formula Syntaxes, Reproducible Research, and Cross-Language Pipelines
scope: Wilkinson-Rogers formula syntax, design matrix construction, and contrast coding schemes
Python statistical API architecture: patsy, statsmodels, and scikit-learn transformers/pipelines
Diagnostic testing: Breusch-Pagan, Durbin-Watson, and Variance Inflation Factors (VIF)
Reproducible statistical pipelines: Quarto/R Markdown, virtual environments, and deterministic seeds
Cross-language statistical data exchange: Apache Arrow zero-copy IPC, reticulate, and rpy2
worked_questions: Construction of contrast coding matrices and algebraic proof of parameter interpretation under treatment vs sum contrasts
Derivation of Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) from auxiliary R_j^2 and numerical diagnosis of collinearity
Zero-copy Apache Arrow IPC memory sharing mechanics between Python and R processes
